cases.expected: Exactly one active Job owns a ConflictKey
cases.observed: Two synchronized threads attempted the same active audit scope; one Job was created and the other operation returned a conflict.

cases.expected: Only one action may commit against a record version
cases.observed: Synchronized resume and cancel requests used the same paused version; one committed and the other received a record-version conflict.

cases.expected: Finish the current atomic unit, checkpoint, and release automatic resources
cases.observed: The Job reached paused with a checkpoint and held no resource lease; resume reused completed download work.

cases.expected: Every changed WorkItem increments its record version and emits an event
cases.observed: The RED test first exposed a changed WorkItem with neither a matching event nor version increment; after the fix, the same pause-boundary test passed with both guarantees.

cases.expected: An atomic resource projection change advances the event cursor for both affected projections
cases.observed: Separate RED checks exposed missing resource.changed and then missing work_item.changed; the final contract test passed with both events.

cases.expected: Preserve committed work and leave another consumer and shared work running
cases.observed: The selected long Job was cancelled, never-started items kept end_reason=not_processed, the short Job succeeded, and its shared evidence work succeeded.

cases.expected: Create a technical failure, not a finance-review item
cases.observed: The Job and WorkItem failed with diagnostic code LOOP3-FAKE-OCR-FAILURE; business_outcome and review_reason remained null and waiting_user stayed zero.

cases.case: failed shared evidence reused by a later consumer
cases.expected: Fail the later consumer deterministically without deadlock or human review
cases.observed: After the shared producer failed, a later short Job failed with LOOP3-FAKE-OCR-FAILURE and produced no business outcome or review reason.

cases.case: application restart with a queued Loop 3 Job
cases.expected: One scheduler owner resumes the Job without a competing legacy runner
cases.observed: A second application instance restored the queued Job to succeeded with no diagnostic, and application state exposed no second runner.

cases.case: three sustained Jobs contend for one resource
cases.observed: The pure scheduling policy selected a, b, c, a, b, c across six grants.

cases.case: suspected swapped and numeric mismatch fixture items
cases.expected: Wait for a person without blocking normal items or holding heavy resources
cases.observed: The two problem simulations remained waiting_user while normal items, the short audit exercise, and the loading probe continued to their expected fixture states.

cases.case: protected fixture used without explicit gate
cases.observed: The loading probe request returned HTTP 403 test_fixture_disabled when the application was not started with the protected fixture gate.

cases.expected: Emit observable paused and cancelled terminal-control events
cases.observed: The event outbox emitted job.paused after the pause boundary and job.cancelled plus work_item.changed after the cancel boundary.
